prompt: Three of the same mascot standing close together as a little group of friends: one in front and centre, two slightly smaller behind it on each side, their speech-bubble bellies overlapping a little. A stylised bottle gourd whose lower bulb is an open speech-bubble shape with a small tail, a short stem and one small lime leaf. No faces; small lime dots between them like chatter. Exactly two colours on a solid very dark violet background (#1D1838): violet #9466FF and lime #B8F34A. No gradients, no shading, no outlines, no text, no faces, large simple geometric shapes, flat vector, minimal and friendly, like a logo-system icon set.
